verdict.rationale: Exa ships an agent API (Exa Agent), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question, but the evidence only shows Exa acting as an MCP server for other clients. Exa Connect attaches curated premium data partners (e.g. ZoomInfo, Crunchbase), which is an adjacent feature, not user-pluggable MCP servers. Nothing shows Exa consuming third-party MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
